solution: 1) Check services WindowsAzureGuestAgent and RdAgent and start them. 2) Run Test-NetConnection 168.63.129.16 -Port 80. 3) Allow 168.63.129.16 in the firewall, NSG and UDRs. 4) Reinstall the agent MSI from aka.ms/vmagentwin.
